cc_updates.body: Added forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting, interactive Bedrock setup wizard, per-model cost breakdown, and fixed subagent spawning issues. Remote Control session names now use hostname as default prefix.
Added MCP tool result persistence override via annotation, disableSkillShellExecution setting, multi-line prompt support in deep links, and plugin executable support under bin/ directory.

Added /powerup interactive lessons, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE env var, and .husky to protected directories. Fixed infinite loop with rate-limit dialog and prompt-cache miss regression.
